title: AWS IAM permissions
description: For a workload or pipeline that uses AWS: temporary credentials, least-privilege policies, policy validation, trust conditions and unused access.

sources.title: AWS IAM Access Analyzer, policy validation
AWS IAM, create a role for OpenID Connect federation

rules.instruction: Give workloads IAM roles and pipelines federated roles with temporary credentials. Do not add IAM user access keys for them.
rules.verification: Search the change and the CI configuration for `aws_access_key_id`, `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` and `aws_iam_access_key` resources.

rules.instruction: Grant the actions and resource ARNs the change needs. Do not add `"Action": "*"` or `"Resource": "*"` without a condition and a recorded reason.
rules.verification: Review each new or changed policy statement for wildcard actions and resources with the security owner.

rules.instruction: Validate new and changed policies with IAM Access Analyzer before applying them.
rules.verification: Run `aws accessanalyzer validate-policy` or the equivalent check in the infrastructure pipeline and attach the findings with their resolution.

rules.instruction: Add conditions to role trust policies that limit who can assume the role, such as the audience and subject claims of a federated identity.
rules.verification: Review the trust policy of each new role for a condition on `aud` and on the subject or source claims.

rules.instruction: Remove roles, policies and permissions the change makes unused, using last accessed information to confirm.
rules.verification: Compare the permissions in the change with the service last accessed data and record the ones removed.
